exposure: Breech presentation diagnosed before 38 weeks' estimated gestational age
Breech presentation diagnosed at or after 38 weeks' estimated gestational age
outcome: Likelihood of external cephalic version attempted
Success rate of external cephalic version
cohort: 251 women with breech presentation at term
finding: Women with breech presentation diagnosed before 38 weeks' estimated gestational age were more likely to have a vaginal delivery because external cephalic version was offered and attempted in a greater proportion of this group.
